selector.rationale: The patient's recent history of Roux-en-Y gastric bypass and the CT findings of a cluster of small-bowel loops with a spiral pattern of mesenteric vessels support Petersen's hernia, a type of internal hernia that can occur after gastric bypass surgery.

rejected.label: Adhesive Bowel Obstruction
rejected.why: No clear evidence of adhesions or bowel obstruction on CT scan

rejected.label: Intestinal Ischemia
rejected.why: Normal lactate level and no signs of bowel ischemia on CT scan

support_spans: Three weeks earlier, she had undergone Roux-en-Y gastric bypass for weight management
Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT demonstrated a cluster of small-bowel loops in the left upper quadrant, positioned anterior to the splenic flexure
The central mesenteric vessels exhibited a spiral (whirl) pattern, with congestion of mesenteric fat and stretching and convergence of vessels
contradict_spans: There were no signs of anastomotic leak, strangulation, or bowel obstruction
